name: Default
shortDescription: Open source helpdesk ticketing system that turns email, web forms and API requests into tracked support tickets, backed by MariaDB.

alerts.message: Set INSTALL_EMAIL and ADMIN_EMAIL to real addresses before the first deploy: the first-start install uses them for the help desk and admin accounts, and later changes are made in the admin panel. Then sign in to the staff panel at /scp as ADMIN_USER (ostadmin) with the generated ADMIN_PASS, and add SMTP and mailbox settings to send and fetch ticket mail.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
